65:6.text: of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.

And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him

65:7.text: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except
what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease

65:8.text: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

65:9.text: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair
, and the outcome of its affair was loss.

65:10.text: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message

65:11.text: reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.

65:12.text: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.
command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
